text:
Hannah: Heads-up everyone 1 Rafi's bday is on Friday. Quick vote: green-tea sampler boxes (ship-friendly, low-sugar) or gourmet macarons (treaty but fragile)?
Sophie: Green tea please 375 ships easier.
Arjun: Macarons are chef-level but risky to ship. :sweat_smile: I vote macarons if we do local-only; otherwise tea.
people-ops-bot: :ballot_box: Poll started  green-tea 1, macarons 1
Hannah: Note we have 5 remote folks. Shipping cost estimate: ~$12/box for tea, ~$18/box for macarons (because of insulated packaging). Budget cap is $110.
Ben: Can we do a hybrid: macarons for folks in SF office, tea for remotes? Keeps it special but avoids breakage.
Sophie: Love hybrid. Also, Rafi is allergic to coconut so please avoid coconut-flavored macarons.
Arjun: I'll handle local pickup for SF. Who's owner for address list and labels?
Hannah: @Ben can you gather remote addresses by Wed EOD?
Ben: Yep compiling now. DM me if you prefer not to share on the thread.
people-ops-bot: :memo: Reminder set "collect addresses" at 1915040000.
Sophie: Also proposing a 1-min surprise video clip during standup + a gif in #general. @Hannah can you queue it?
Hannah: Yep will add to slideshow. Also setting a short Zoom confetti sticker for the call.
Ben: If anyone wants to chip in for a slightly nicer box for Rafi, Venmo @redwood-bday (put "Rafi"). Suggest $5 optional.
Arjun: Final check on diet restrictions: coconut noted. Any gluten-free request?
Sophie: Rafi is fine with gluten.
Hannah: Plan: hybrid approved. Owner assignments: Arjun=pickup, Ben=addresses + fund collection, Sophie=card. Thanks team! :tada:
people-ops-bot: :tada: Thread closed  plan=hybrid, budget_est=$110, remotes=5, owners=[Arjun,Ben,Sophie].
